# ELV8 Energy Shop

ELV8 is a premium next-generation energy drink formulated with natural caffeine, electrolytes, and ingredients for mental clarity (like L-Theanine), with zero sugar.

## Main Pages
- [Home Page](https://elv8now.com/) - Main product features, benefits, testimonials.
- [Products Catalog](https://elv8now.com/products) - Browse all flavors, packs, and sizes.
- [About Us](https://elv8now.com/about) - Learn about our mission and clean energy formula.
- [Store Locator](https://elv8now.com/store-locator) - Find local stores and stockists near you.
- [B2B Wholesale Portal](https://elv8now.com/b2b-wholesale) - Form for business partners and distributors.
- [Payment Methods](https://elv8now.com/payment-methods) - Information about accepted payment options (Credit/Debit Card).

## API & Integrations
- [WooCommerce API](https://store.elv8now.com/wp-json/wc/v3) - For product retrieval and order processing.
- [Store Locator Endpoint](https://store.elv8now.com/wp-json/elv8/v1/stores) - Retrieves list of retail stores.
- [Wholesale Submission](https://store.elv8now.com/wp-json/elv8/v1/wholesale-submit) - Endpoint for B2B applications.
